lessons.title: Lesson 1: The Basics

topics.title: Core Content
topics.body: Variables are the building blocks of programming.

topics.title: Real-World Analogy
topics.body: Think of variables like containers that hold things.

topics.title: Concept Explanation
topics.body:
1. Variables store data.
2. Data types tell the program what kind of data it is.

topics.title: Common Mistakes
topics.body:
1. Forgetting to declare variables
2. Using the wrong data type

topics.title: Best Practices
topics.body:
1. Use descriptive variable names
2. Comment your code

topics.title: Industry Notes
topics.body: Professional developers follow these practices every day.

topics.title: Key Takeaways
topics.body:
1. Variables are containers
2. Data types matter

topics.title: Examples
topics.body:
Example 1: Variables in action
Example 2: Working with data types

topics.title: Summary
topics.body: You've learned the basics of variables and data types!
